progression.narrative: The performance opens on Cs4 and dwells most on E in Shekaste. Chaharmezrab (0:06.4) introduces B, centred on E. Forud (0:54.6) introduces D, centred on E. The line peaks at E4 (344.2 Hz) at 1:58.4. It closes on the tonic (E4 → A2 → A3 → A2 → A2 → A2).
